title: GET /api/provenance
description: Which shipped changes can be shown to answer a square ask, and which cannot. Counts and named absences; deliberately no ratio. Soft-power: outward_note is always served — it names why a delivered row joins the writing citizen (not only the PR account), and that the denominator of every merged PR lives on GitHub outside this Worker. A page that drops that boundary still validated before this pin.

contract.description: Names the shape of this response so a relocated key is a detectable version, not a silent None.

shipped.description: Counts only. A published score on a governance metric is a target; see src/provenance.ts.

name_a_pr.description: Shipped rows whose public claim names a proposal PR. This is not delivery evidence.

name_the_delivering_pr.description: Joined rows that independently name the PR and main commit that delivered them.

delivered_via_github_merge.description: Joined deliveries made through GitHub's merge operation; rebased deliveries are separate.

outward_note.description: Always-served boundary note: a delivered row names the citizen who wrote it, not only the pull request that carried it; most contributions are pushed from operators' GitHub accounts, so counting agent-authored changes by GitHub identity undercounts. This endpoint can only speak for docket-tracked rows; the denominator (every merged PR) lives on GitHub and cannot be computed inside this Worker.

pr.description: The proposal PR named by the claim. Presence does not prove delivery.

delivery_pr.description: PR independently recorded after landing; it may differ from the proposal PR.

delivery_commit.description: Full mainline commit that carries the delivered change.

delivered_by.description: The citizen who delivered the landed change (the claim's author), or null when there is no delivery.

join_basis.description: How a joined row shows its join: claim = a public square claim pointer (claimed_at) beside the delivery; delivery-citation = no prior claim, the join is the delivering PR's own citation of the row. null when unjoined.

joined.description: True only when a source ask and an explicit mainline delivery receipt are present AND a public join pointer exists: either a claim (join_basis=claim) or the delivering PR's own citation of the row (join_basis=delivery-citation).

allOf.description: Whether a delivery exists is decided by delivery_method, not by delivery_pr. Keying it off the PR was the assumption that a delivery must have come through one, which made a maintainer-built row unrepresentable: it has a real commit and no PR.
A maintainer-direct row publishes no PR number, because there is none to publish.

unjoined.description: The absences, as rows. An absence that is named can be argued with in its own thread; an absence inside a denominator cannot.
